items.detail: The binary reads a real file through a real tool call over the Responses wire.
items.label: OpenAI Responses

items.detail: The binary drives the Messages wire and calls a real tool through it.
items.label: Anthropic Messages

items.detail: A short model name resolves to the exact identifier this build pins.
items.label: Provider presets

items.detail: Naming your own credential turns the preset's token renewal off, so no file is rewritten that the operator did not offer.
items.label: Credentials the operator names

items.detail: A run or server without the secrets flag never dials the session bus.
items.label: Secrets store only on request

items.detail: A turn ceiling stops the loop, and the stop names the ceiling.
items.label: Turn ceiling

items.detail: A spend ceiling on a run that cannot price its model is refused before the first request.
items.label: Spend ceiling

items.detail: A model the rate card does not price has no cost rather than a zero one.
items.label: Unpriced is not free

items.detail: Usage a provider did not report stays unknown rather than becoming zero.
items.label: Unreported usage

items.detail: A declared context window compacts on the token count the provider reported.
items.label: Compaction

items.detail: Cancellation between tool calls stops the run before the next effect.
items.label: Cancellation

items.detail: A run asked for a schema that answers in prose stops without an answer.
items.label: Structured output

items.detail: A run entry built from the process adapter is refused under the default approver.
items.label: Deny by default

items.detail: A write is refused when the run has nobody it may ask.
items.label: No silent approval

items.detail: Raising the unattended ceiling lets a write through, on either wire.
items.label: Approval ceiling

items.detail: A path the write scope denies is refused for both writers, and the refusal says the scope is what is wrong.
items.label: Write scope

items.detail: A declared program with no confinement is reported as withheld rather than dropped.
items.label: Withheld tools are reported

items.detail: The verbs surface publishes three tools over the same catalogue.
items.label: Verb surface

items.detail: An MCP server named in a reviewed profile runs end to end over stdio.
items.label: Outbound MCP

items.detail: The tools command describes the toolset without an endpoint.
items.label: Toolset description

items.detail: Every profile that contributed to a run is in its record with its own digest.
items.label: Profiles

items.detail: The default write scope denies the repository's own Git directory.
items.label: Default write scope

items.detail: A declared context file that is absent refuses the run before any session is filed.
items.label: Declared context files

items.detail: A run files its conversation, and a later run resumes it.
items.label: Resume

items.detail: A session directory inside the workspace is refused before it is created.
items.label: Sessions stay outside the workspace

items.detail: JSON mode emits one event per line.
items.label: JSON events

items.detail: A delegate runs a whole second loop, and the parent reads only its report.
items.label: Delegation

items.detail: Two delegates of one turn run at the same time.
items.label: Concurrent delegates

items.detail: A named agent cannot widen what the parent run was admitted.
items.label: Named agents

items.detail: Skill descriptions are in the instruction, and their bodies are not until the model asks.
items.label: Skills

items.detail: recall answers a memory's body, and the record names every memory whatever its status.
items.label: Read-only memories

items.detail: A stop hook blocks one ending, and the run turns again before it finishes.
items.label: Stop hooks

items.detail: A hook file naming a point that does not exist is refused by name.
items.label: Hook points

items.detail: A tool call round trips back to the client that registered the tool.
items.label: Tool calls round trip

items.detail: The client methods served and refused match the pinned profile manifest.
items.label: Pinned method inventory

items.detail: A real external client drives bridge mode end to end, beyond the contract tests.
items.label: Driven by a real external client

items.detail: The agent loop's turn, tool and budget behaviour is modelled in the executable specification and run by its conformance suite.
items.label: The loop in the executable specification

source: harness-docs, from its capability list; every shipped item names the test that holds it
